page_title: WHU 2-1 MNU | West Ham v Manchester Utd 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' That's the end of the match.
90+14' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
90+9' Emerson (West Ham) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Andre Onana.
90+7' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+6' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+5' Emerson (West Ham) has tested the patience of referee David Coote and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' It's time for a substitution. Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) comes on in place of Guido Rodriguez.
90+2' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Andre Onana no chance!
90+2' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is going to take the penalty!
90' We will have 12 min. of added time.
90' The West Ham players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
88' Referee David Coote makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for West Ham. Let’s see what happens!
87' PENALTY APPEAL after Danny Ings (West Ham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
87' The resulting corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
86' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham). The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

85' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
84' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) replacing Noussair Mazraoui.
83' It doesn’t look good for Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
81' 1 - 1 GOAL! Casemiro (Manchester United) scores with a header from close range after Joshua Zirkzee headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:1.
79' Substitution. Christian Eriksen will be replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
79' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Manchester Utd get a corner.
78' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

78' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
77' A dangerous looking corner kick from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.

76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Manchester Utd earn a corner.
74' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) picks up a caution.

74' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Danny Ings, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham), who beats Andre Onana with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 1:0.
73' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
73' Emerson (West Ham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
72' Emerson (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Emerson (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. West Ham have a corner.
71' Substitution. Danny Ings (West Ham) on for Michail Antonio.
67' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' The total number of attempts is 6:11.
64' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Max Kilman (West Ham), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
64' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) trips an opposition player and David Coote signals a foul.
63' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the right post.
62' Michail Antonio (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Emerson.
59' Substitution. Marcus Rashford makes his way off the pitch and Amad Diallo (Manchester United) comes on as his replacement.
59' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. David Coote had an easy-decision to make.
59' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
58' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.

58' A snap shot by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski produces a good save to thwart him. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Michail Antonio (West Ham) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) does well to meet a cross from Marcus Rashford, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
53' Michail Antonio (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
52' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
51' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
51' Andre Onana (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
48' The game is interrupted now, Andre Onana (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Carlos Soler (West Ham) is replaced by Crysencio Summerville.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Julen Lopetegui gives a chance to Tomas Soucek and Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julen Lopetegui probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham). He is replaced by Jean-Clair Todibo.
46' The whistle blows and David Coote starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Good defending. Emerson (West Ham) tries to find Carlos Soler inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

45+1' Casemiro (Manchester United) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A pass into the penalty area from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence.
44' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is moving okay again after that injury scare. Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Flag up against Michail Antonio (West Ham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
40' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
39' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester Utd are going to take it.
39' 1:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
36' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) brings his opponent down. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd have a free kick from a promising distance.
33' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) squandered a big chance from inside the box, firing his volley narrowly over the bar. What a waste.
30' David Coote shows a yellow card to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) heads on.
28' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
28' Carlos Soler (West Ham) will take the corner.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
23' Andre Onana comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
22' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. West Ham win a corner kick.
21' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) threads a pass through to Marcus Rashford, but Lukasz Fabianski breaks up the move.
21' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) tries to find Jarrod Bowen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
19' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' The corner by Emerson (West Ham) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
18' Michail Antonio (West Ham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham).
13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
13' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
12' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
12' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' The percentage of ball possession is – 34:66.

9' Golden chance! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' A player from Manchester Utd commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and West Ham will have the kick-off.
David Coote is introduced as the referee for today's match.
